negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak-language newsroom or press-release archive was found for Visa or Mastercard covering Slovakia. SK-relevant scheme news (e.g. Click to Pay arriving in Slovakia) was only observable via the pan-European Mastercard newsroom and via SK tech-media pickup (touchit.sk).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk and en returned only global/Europe newsrooms plus a Mastercard Slovakia Instagram account; no sk press-release index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK scheme announcements must be caught downstream (SK media, agency tag pages) rather than at source, which adds latency and attribution risk.

negative_findings.description: Neither Worldline nor Nexi discloses Slovakia as a reporting unit. Worldline group FY/H1 releases name Italy, Switzerland, UK, Germany, France and Belgium but not Slovakia; Nexi reports Slovakia only inside an aggregated CSEE segment alongside Poland, Croatia, Hungary and Serbia.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK line item found in any group-level acquirer/processor disclosure reviewed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK acquiring/processing revenue can only be reconstructed from SK statutory filings (registeruz/ORSR), not from group investor materials - this shapes the whole collection design for cell 07.

negative_findings.description: Two Global Payments SK legal vehicles appear as dissolved/in liquidation in Slovak registry aggregators: 'Global Payments Europe Slovakia, s.r.o. v likvidacii' (ICO 43854958) and 'Global Payments Europe, s.r.o., organizacna zlozka' (ICO 35893630). The live vehicle appears to be 'Global Payments s.r.o., organizacna zlozka' (ICO 50010301, Vajnorska 100/B, Bratislava).
negative_findings.result_summary: Registry-aggregator listings flag [zrusena]/v likvidacii for the two older entities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collecting against a stale ICO would silently produce empty or misleading SK financials; the entity map for this actor must be pinned to ICO 50010301 and re-checked.

negative_findings.description: No separate Slovak-registered Worldline legal entity was identified in this pass. Worldline appears to serve SK through worldline.com/sk-sk, a platobnyterminal.sk.worldline.com subdomain and the chcemterminal.sk channel site, suggesting cross-border/branch service rather than a SK a.s./s.r.o.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'Worldline Slovakia s.r.o.' and NBS listings returned no SK-incorporated Worldline entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If there is no SK entity, no SK statutory accounts exist for Worldline and its SK footprint must be inferred from NBS passporting records and channel/pricing evidence instead.

negative_findings.description: The NBS PSD2 register API endpoint (https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2) and the ZBK statistics page (https://zbk.sk/statisticke-udaje/) were identified from search results but were not fetched in this pass, so their current response shape and content depth are unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as high-confidence candidates with unverified liveness; not treated as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should prioritise these two, as both are load-bearing for the actor map and the acceptance-side time series.

negative_findings.description: No public source was found disclosing SK merchant-acquiring market shares (by turnover or merchant/terminal count) split between Global Payments, Worldline, Nexi and bank-owned acquirers. ZBK and SBA statistics are aggregate, not per-acquirer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both sk and en queries returned only aggregate card statistics and vendor marketing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any market-share view for SK acceptance will have to be modelled from statutory revenue filings plus terminal-estate proxies, not read off a published source.

coverage_gaps.description: First Data legacy estate in SK was only traced as far as the First Data -> SIA Central Europe -> Nexi Central Europe lineage (ICO 31372074). Any residual Fiserv (First Data successor) presence in SK - e.g. Fiserv/Clover distribution or a separate SK entity - was not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sk+en queries on 'Fiserv Slovensko', 'Clover Slovensko', 'First Data Slovakia' and check ORSR/registeruz for Fiserv-named entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned/bank-branded acquiring in SK beyond the Erste/SLSP-Global Payments JV was not mapped: Tatra banka, VUB (Intesa), CSOB (KBC), Postova banka/365.bank acceptance offerings and which processor sits behind each.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each major SK bank, crawl the merchant/'prijimanie platieb kartou' pages and identify the named acquirer/processor; cross-check against the ZBK member list.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement (UVO - Urad pre verejne obstaravanie / vestnik) was not searched. Tenders for card acceptance and POS terminal services by SK public bodies would name bidders, award values and per-transaction pricing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add UVO vestnik keyword monitoring for 'akceptacia platobnych kariet', 'platobne terminaly', 'sluzby akceptacie kariet' alongside CRZ contract monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: No conference/industry-event source was harvested for this cell beyond noting ZBK's /podujatia page. Event agendas and speaker lists are a reliable way to discover processors, gateway vendors and terminal OEMs active in SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest ZBK event agendas and any SK payments conference programmes; snowball speaker company names into the actor register.

coverage_gaps.description: The May 2026 SK QR-payment / notifikacne ucty (NOP) rollout by Financna sprava and major banks was seen only in passing. It is a structural threat/alternative to card acceptance and directly relevant to acquirer and terminal-estate economics in SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Financna sprava SR (financnasprava.sk) and the NOP/QR programme pages as a monitored source and assess its effect on terminal-estate growth.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language coverage was achieved for all local actors, registries and media. However, no Hungarian- or Czech-language searching was done, despite Nexi Central Europe running SK from a shared CZ/HU/HR/RS platform - CZ-language disclosure often carries SK-relevant operational detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Czech-language query pass ('Nexi Ceska republika zpracovani karet', 'Global Payments Europe s.r.o. vyrocni zprava') to capture shared-platform disclosures.

brief: Slovakia's acceptance side is structurally opaque at country level: the three multinational actors (Global Payments via the 2015 Erste/CaixaBank JV, Nexi via Bratislava-domiciled Nexi Central Europe a.s. - the ex-SIA, ex-First Data CEE processing estate - and Worldline via a cross-border sk-sk offering) all fold Slovakia into 'Europe' or 'CSEE' segments and never disclose an SK line item. The usable intelligence therefore splits three ways: group IR/SEC filings for strategy, contract wins and JV economics; Slovak statutory registries (registeruz.sk by ICO, ORSR, NBS PSD2 register with its daily API) for the only real SK-level financials and licence entries/exits; and Slovak-language aggregate and indirect sources - SBA's monthly issuing-and-acceptance card statistics, ZBK's 22-member roster, the CRZ public-contract register with full-text acceptance contracts, and SK trade media (FinReport, SITA tag pages) - for volumes, actor discovery and observable pricing. Priority next steps are mapping bank-branded acquiring behind each major SK bank, resolving the Fiserv/First Data legacy question, and adding UVO procurement to reach acquirer pricing that no party publishes voluntarily.
